transport.header_or_cookie: Not a request credential — a static configured license string (<payload_b64>.<signature_b64>)
transport.shape: Ed25519-signed JSON payload (LicensePayload), base64 payload + base64 signature

validators.description: LicenseValidator.validate: VerifyKey.verify against a configured public key, then expiry/grace-period check
require_feature() gates SSO and other enterprise features on a valid, feature-entitled license

bootstrap.local_compose: compose.yml env vars (POSTGRES_URI/CLICKHOUSE_URI etc., not individually anchored here)
bootstrap.production: k8s-managed

gaps: This class was time-boxed to file-existence checks only (deploy/kubernetes/secrets.yaml, deploy/helm/.../serviceaccount.yaml exist). No line-level anchors for how DB/K8s/TLS credentials are read, validated, or rotated in application code were produced this pass. This is the least-verified class in the inventory and should be the first thing a follow-up lane deepens.

issuer.description: Cluster/orchestration layer (k8s Secrets, Helm values); not minted by ops/web/acr application code

rotation.description: not anchored this pass

transport.header_or_cookie: not_applicable — infra-layer, not an application request credential
transport.shape: Postgres/ClickHouse connection URIs, k8s ServiceAccount tokens, TLS certs/keys

validators.description: Not anchored — this pass only located the deployment manifests that reference these identities, not the code paths that consume/validate them (DB client TLS config, k8s API server auth)
